question: Who was awarded the Mother Teresa Memorial Award for Social Justice 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Prakash Joshi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Dr Anil Prakash Joshi, an environmentalist, was awarded the Mother Teresa Memorial Award for Social Justice 2021. He was also conferred upon with the Padma Bhushan this year.
 
• The other recipients of the Mother Teresa Memorial Award were Vidyut Mohan, the winner of the Earth-shot Prize, and Ridhima Pandey, a young environmental activist from Uttarakhand.
 
• The Harmony Foundation holds the Mother Teresa Memorial Awards annually, and selects a theme each year. For this year, the theme was environmental sustainability.
 
• The foundation's founder chairman, Dr Abraham Mathai, felicitated the awardees.
 
• Dr Joshi received the award for his work that affected over 10,000 villages in the Himalayan region through his organization, the Himalayan Environmental Studies & Conservation Organization.
 
• Vidyut Mohan was acknowledged for his creative efforts in fighting air pollution through his social enterprise Takachar.
 
• Ridhima Pandey received the award for her exceptional courage and unyielding spirit as a youth environmental activist, whose efforts have spurred national engagement in stopping climate change.
